[[File:Portrait roderick.jpg|140px|left|link=House Ashbourne]]
'''[[House Ashbourne]]''' worships the daring leap: hesitation is the only true loss. Its fortress [[Dawnwatch]] is built for sallying forth, not for siege, and on its Wall of Names every fallen rider is carved by their own next of kin. Its head, [[Roderick Ashbourne]], rode twelve Leaps. He no longer carves names himself.
